title: Find the Words That Can Start a Match
text: The pattern begins with [Hh]o, so a match must start with Ho or ho. Then \w* can continue matching word characters until the required space.

title: First Captured Match
text: In the substring Homework $$6$$, what does the capturing group (\w+) return after the regex has matched Homework and the space?

title: Remember Only the Capturing Group Is Returned
text: The parentheses are around the final \w+, so re.findall returns only the word after the matched Ho... word and space, not the entire matched phrase.

title: Check the Second Match Carefully
text: However is not a match because it is followed by a comma, not a space. Later, honestly proud fits the pattern, so proud is captured.

title: Combine Matches in List Order
text: re.findall returns all captured matches from left to right. The captures are $$6$$ and proud, so the output list is ['6','proud'].
